decisions.reason: Although the superfood drink mix is less central to the firm's waste-to-value core, it is already publicly mentioned and recent, so escalation of commitment makes a near-term drop unlikely.
As a modular extension of the established waste-to-energy offer, the firm has invested resources and publicly committed to it, so management is likely to persist.
With a dedicated webpage and a central waste-oil-to-energy scope, the product is highly visible and committed, creating strong escalation pressures to keep it.
Close to the established offer and publicly mentioned, the plastic-to-fuel plant benefits from sunk investments and public commitment, leading to persistence.
